observation: A font-free seven-segment position-label concept created 177 Boolean cutters for twenty positions and remained in the label-cut phase beyond the command's 30-second output yield. The final two-bar tens/units encoding uses 29 cutters and the complete cassette/card build finished in 23.8 seconds.

initial_design.measurement: diagnostic build entered label cutting and did not finish within the 30-second command yield

final_design.encoding: two horizontal bars whose lengths encode tens and units

correction: Keep the position identity in the parametric data model.
Use at most one nonzero tens bar and one nonzero units bar per position.
Protect the Boolean budget with a deterministic unit test.
Do not generalize this code system without checking readability for the target use.
limitations: One CadQuery/OpenCascade model and one workstation were observed.
The initial run was terminated after the diagnostic threshold, so its completion time is unknown.
Physical code readability has not been tested.
